externalRefs.title: Main Board DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of bare mainboard owned by external Main Board DVT. This document begins at assembled-controller boundary; bare-board electrical functional.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed Main Board DVT on record for mainboard serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copy attached to this run as artifact. Section B does not begin until Section A artifact is present.

externalRefs.title: MIB DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of each MIB board owned by external MIB DVT. MIB-board electrical functional, AOI, and SPI-side functional testing owned by that document and not repeated here. This DVT begins MIB coverage at assembled-controller / FCAT-fixture boundary in Section F.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed MIB DVT on record for every MIB serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copies attached to this run as artifacts. Section D does not begin until all MIB DVT artifacts are present.
